description_en: Queries columns and detection results of a data table
description_zh: 查询数据表列及识别结果
name: ListColumns

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the detection rule or model. Set this parameter to the ID of the corresponding detection rule in the target template
parameters.help_zh: 识别规则或模型标识，取目标模板内对应识别规则的 Id
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The compatible parameter for the instance identity. DataAssetSourceId takes precedence. If both are specified, DataAssetSourceId is used
parameters.help_zh: 实例标识的兼容参数。优先使用 DataAssetSourceId；同时传入时以 DataAssetSourceId 为准
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the data table. For PostgreSQL or Oracle scenarios, retain the schema.table format obtained from the table list
parameters.help_zh: 数据表名称。PostgreSQL 或 Oracle 场景应保留从表列表取得的 schema.table 形式
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number, starting from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The sensitivity level ID. You can obtain this value from the list returned by ListRiskLevels
parameters.help_zh: 敏感等级标识，可从 ListRiskLevels 的返回列表获取
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud database instance identity. Set this parameter to the InstanceId from the instance list
parameters.help_zh: 云上数据库实例标识，取实例列表中的 InstanceId
parameters.name: data_asset_source_id

parameters.help_en: The database name. Set this parameter to the DbName returned by ListDataSources
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称，取 ListDataSources 返回的 DbName
parameters.name: data_source_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification and grading template. You can obtain this value from Items[].Id returned by ListTemplates. Ensure consistency with the selected sensitivity level and detection model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. This value must match the EngineType of the target instance, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型，应与目标实例的 EngineType 一致，例如 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine_type

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by this query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time of the data object. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 数据对象的创建时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

DataType.description_en: The data type of the database column

InstanceName.description_en: The cloud instance identity to which the column belongs. This is a compatible field
InstanceName.description_zh: 列所属的云上实例标识，兼容字段

MaskingStatus.description_en: The compatible field for column encryption status. To query column encryption results, call ListDataMaskingColumns
MaskingStatus.description_zh: 列加密状态兼容字段。列加密结果查询使用 ListDataMaskingColumns

Name.description_en: The name of the data column

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the asset

RevisionId.description_en: The ID of the detection result revision record
RevisionId.description_zh: 识别结果订正记录标识

RevisionStatus.description_en:
The revision status of the detection result. Valid values:
0: not revised.
1: revised
RevisionStatus.description_zh: 识别结果订正状态。0：未订正；1：已订正

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the matched detection rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the matched detection rule

Sensitive.description_en: Indicates whether the data is detected as sensitive data

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page for this query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
